payload.title: Tue 11/10: Referring providers: who is the right referral
payload.purpose: Standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, or alongside bariatric surgery or weight loss medication. Pre and post bariatric patients in one bullet.

captions.LI:
The Bariatric Counseling Center serves patients seeking standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, as well as those receiving bariatric surgery or weight loss medications from their medical providers.

Our intensive outpatient program supports pre-surgical and post-surgical bariatric patients. We coordinate care with referring providers and deliver detailed discharge summaries of behavioral progress, including changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression.

The staff is comprised of a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef. One program, not four.

We accept most health insurances. Claims are processed under patients' mental health benefits. Patients typically attend for little to no cost.

Serving patients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BehavioralHealth
captions.GBP:
The Bariatric Counseling Center provides intensive outpatient treatment for patients seeking standalone behavioral healthcare for obesity, or as a complement to bariatric surgery or weight loss medications they receive from their medical providers. Our program supports pre-surgical and post-surgical bariatric patients with comprehensive behavioral treatment.

We coordinate care with referring providers throughout treatment. At discharge, we deliver detailed summaries of patient behavioral progress, including changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression. Progress notes as requested, typically within two business days.

The staff is comprised of a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef. One program, not four. Serving patients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.
